title: Way smaller than expected, made of plastic
text: Way smaller than expected, made of plastic. I am keeping this because I like how it looks from afar. However, it was way smaller than expected (burn on me for not checking, I guess) and was made of plastic, cheapening it a bit. Photo has a pen for scale- not quite sure who you’d “serve” on this tray- a hamster or other small mammal?? Certainly not a person
